judge.text: - The approval check reads `get_workorder::response`, but the approval is confirmed by the `authority_get_approval` lookup, which has its own permit. As written, a work order lookup that reports `approval_outcome` = "SIGNED_OFF" and `approver_type` = "OPERATOR" is accepted as the approval. A completed `authority_get_approval` call that confirmed the approval does not satisfy the policy, so closing is denied in cases the intent allows. This mismatch rests on my assumption about which tool carries the approval fields, because the action schema was not provided.
